phonics_focus: Short vowel sounds: 'a' as in 'class' and 'hat'. Listen for the short 'a' sound in the key words.

vocabulary.definition: feeling worried or scared about something
a room in a school where students learn
to tell people your name for the first time
to greet someone in a warm and happy way

article_paragraphs.text: Today was Mia's first day at her new school. She stood at the door of the classroom and felt very nervous. She did not know anyone. She looked at all the students sitting at their desks and took a deep breath.

The teacher smiled and said, 'Class, we have a new student. Her name is Mia. Please make her feel welcome.' A girl named Sara raised her hand. 'Mia, you can sit next to me!' she said in a friendly voice.

At lunch, Sara introduced Mia to more friends. They talked and laughed together. By the end of the day, Mia did not feel nervous anymore. She smiled all the way home. She could not wait to come back tomorrow.
